test_missing_version_treated_as_zero: test that a config without config_version is treated as version zero and emits a warning
test_matching_version_no_warning: test that matching config versions between user and example configs emit no warning
test_outdated_version_emits_warning: test that a config with a lower version than the example emits an outdated warning
test_string_config_version_does_not_rais: test that a string config_version does not raise TypeError during comparison
test_no_example_file_no_warning: test that a missing config.example.yaml file produces no outdated warning
